workers.title: Queue workers
workers.hint: Each definition runs on its own systemd units. Give a high priority queue its own worker instead of sharing one set of timings with everything else.
workers.loadFailed: The worker list could not be read, so it is not shown here.
workers.scheduleHint: Runs artisan schedule:run once a minute.
workers.name: Name
workers.maxJobs: Jobs before restart (0 means no limit)
workers.logEmpty: The worker has written nothing yet.
workers.confirmStop: Stop {{name}}? Its queue will not be processed until it is started again.
workers.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Its processes stop and the definition is gone.
workers.saveFailed: The worker could not be saved.

reasons.laravel_worker_name_invalid: The name may hold lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only, and must start with a letter or a digit.
reasons.laravel_worker_connection_invalid: The connection name may hold lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
reasons.laravel_worker_queues_invalid: A queue name may hold letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores only, must start with a letter or a digit, and there may be at most eight of them.
reasons.laravel_worker_value_out_of_range: One of the numbers is outside the range shown beside its field.
reasons.laravel_worker_name_taken: A worker with that name already exists on this domain.
reasons.laravel_worker_unknown: That worker does not belong to this domain.
reasons.laravel_worker_apply_failed: The definition was saved but the worker did not start.
